vignette: An adolescent is being planned for orthognathic surgery, and CBCT images have been obtained for orthodontic and surgical planning.
stem: Which statement about handling these CBCT images is most appropriate?

options.text: Consulting a radiologist to interpret the images may be indicated, because CBCT can capture information beyond the original purpose
Review should be limited to the original purpose, because CBCT captures nothing else
CBCT is not helpful for surgical planning before orthognathic surgery
Radiologist interpretation of CBCT is never indicated
